question: DKJE is related to IPOJ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, GTSM is related to LYXR. To which of the following is RBNF related to, following the same logic?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] The logic followed here is :- (5) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series. ​So, • DKJE is written as IPOJ ​
